_comment: Umezawa's Jitte's non-combat counter modes must be expressible as a viewer LINE (2026-08-23). They are enumerated ONLY in human play (the autonomous search prunes them -- USER doctrine 2026-08-14: goldfishing always spends counters on the +2/+2) and only while the Jitte actually holds charge counters, so no self-driving sweep reaches them; hand-build the charged board. jittemode=1 is the -1/-1 mode; the LineSpec verb names the MODE INT, which is why a Jitte click opens the queue-time ability picker in the GUI rather than guessing. The gain-2-life mode (jittemode=2) used to be a KNOWN GAP here -- emitted as a candidate but never surviving into an enumerated plan -- until the 2026-08-26 BuildEquipPieceDeps fix; it now has its own fixture, kitty_jitte_lifegain_line.json.
